# 6UMMY

> DJ, collector and curator based in Montevideo, Uruguay. Techno, House,
> and Rares. Livestreams, gigs, and vinyl since 2004.

Personal site. Single page, bilingual (English / Spanish), no tracking,
no cookies. Live data is served from a Cloudflare Worker; everything
degrades to readable text if it is unreachable.

## Identity
- Name: 6UMMY (also written 6ummy)
- Based: Montevideo, Uruguay (UTC-3)
- Active since: 2004
- Formats: vinyl and digital
- Styles: techno, house, rares
- Contact: sync@6ummy.xyz

## Sections
- Stream — live Twitch status and player
- Dates — upcoming gigs, falls back to recent past dates
- Sets — recorded SoundCloud sessions
- Portfolio — curated YouTube playlist
- Crate — record collection, newest first, from Discogs
- Elsewhere — profiles and projects
- Bookings & contact
